exodus.37.p1.b1.text: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

exodus.37.p1.b2.text: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.

exodus.37.p1.b3.text: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it.

exodus.37.p1.b4.text: And the cherubim had wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the mercy seat.

exodus.37.p2.b5.text: He also made the table of acacia wood … He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.

exodus.37.p2.b6.text: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings.

exodus.37.p2.b7.text: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

exodus.37.p2.b8.text: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold.

exodus.37.p3.b9.text: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square … Its horns were of one piece.

exodus.37.p3.b10.text: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
